instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium-full shot captures a couple spinning on a grassy hilltop. In the foreground, the man in the red striped shirt (R2) is seen from behind, wearing brown trousers and loafers. In the midground, the woman in the yellow cardigan (R1) faces the camera, smiling widely in blue jeans and white sneakers. They hold hands as they spin together on the green grass, with a vast landscape of rolling mountains and an overcast sky in the background.
